title: Thai Seven Spice Blend
description: From the r/hellofresh DIY spice blend master list, scaled so one batch (about 3 tsp) replaces one sachet. Original ratio: 2.5 sesame seeds, 1 chilli flakes, 1 ground coriander, 1 onion powder, 0.5 garlic powder, 0.25 ground cinnamon, 0.125 cayenne pepper. The original includes ½ tsp shrimp extract powder; it's left out here to keep the blend vegetarian.

steps.text: Mix everything in a small bowl. Use the whole batch wherever a recipe calls for 1 sachet.
To keep a jar: multiply every amount by the same number (e.g. ×8 fills a small spice jar).
